title: Gorp Review Decision
description: Wave D contract (retry added Sprint 5A). The single, immutable review decision for one run. Written exactly once by `gorp approve`, `gorp reject`, or `gorp retry`; never edited. 'approved' and 'rejected' are terminal for the node; 'retry' is terminal FOR THIS RUN ONLY — it returns the node to pending for a fresh attempt (new runId, new records) while this run's records and chain are retained unchanged. Linked to the gate record it judged by gateRecordSha256 and to the exact reviewed artifact by reviewedArtifactHash.

reviewedArtifactHash.description: The exact sandbox commit the reviewer judged. Must equal the gate record's validation.artifactHash.

gateRecordSha256.description: SHA-256 of the persisted gate-record file bytes at decision time. Binds the decision to the exact gate the reviewer saw.
